meta.title: PowerShell Microsoft 365: commands and cheatsheet
meta.description: PowerShell cheatsheet for Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, Graph, Entra ID, Teams, SharePoint, with module, permissions, example and common pitfall.
meta.intro: Cmdlets of the current modules (Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph PowerShell, Teams, SharePoint Online). MSOnline and AzureAD are deprecated: use Microsoft Graph PowerShell.
meta.card: Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID, Teams, SharePoint, Intune, Defender/Purview: cmdlet, module, permissions, example, pitfall, plus ready-to-use export scripts.

top.title: Connecting
top.note: Install the modules first (once) with Install-Module -Scope CurrentUser, then connect at each session.

items.note: Exchange Online (ExchangeOnlineManagement module). Add -ShowBanner:$false for shorter output. Disconnect: Disconnect-ExchangeOnline -Confirm:$false.

Microsoft Graph PowerShell: request only the scopes you need (least privilege). Check with Get-MgContext. Common scopes: User.ReadWrite.All, Group.ReadWrite.All, Directory.ReadWrite.All, Policy.Read.All, DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All, AuditLog.Read.All.
Teams (MicrosoftTeams module). Teams Administrator role or higher.
SharePoint Online (Microsoft.Online.SharePoint.PowerShell module), admin center URL. Alternative: PnP.PowerShell.
Security & Compliance (Defender, Purview): same module as Exchange Online.

meta.notice: MSOnline and AzureAD (Msol* and *-AzureAD* cmdlets) are deprecated and no longer receive fixes: migrate to Microsoft Graph PowerShell (Mg*). Test with -WhatIf first when it exists.

entries.name: Get-Mailbox
entries.desc: Lists mailboxes or shows a mailbox's properties.
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: Without -ResultSize Unlimited, only 1,000 results are returned.

entries.name: Set-Mailbox
entries.desc: Changes a mailbox (quota, address, forwarding, archive, retention).
entries.pitfall: External forwarding is often blocked by the tenant's outbound anti-spam policy.

entries.name: Set-MailboxAutoReplyConfiguration
entries.desc: Enables, schedules or turns off a mailbox's out-of-office automatic reply (internal and external message).
ex: Set-MailboxAutoReplyConfiguration -Identity user@contoso.com -AutoReplyState Enabled -InternalMessage 'Absent jusqu''au 5 janvier.' -ExternalMessage 'Absent jusqu''au 5 janvier.'
entries.pitfall: Without -ExternalMessage, external senders get nothing; -ExternalAudience (Known or All) narrows or widens who receives the reply.

entries.name: New-Mailbox
entries.desc: Creates a shared mailbox (or room/equipment with -Room, -Equipment).
entries.pitfall: A shared mailbox needs no licence as long as it stays under 50 GB with no archive.

entries.name: Add-MailboxPermission
entries.desc: Gives full access to a mailbox (read/write delegation).
entries.pitfall: Allow 30 to 60 minutes for propagation; also add Add-RecipientPermission for 'Send as'.

entries.name: Add-RecipientPermission
entries.desc: Allows 'Send as' on a mailbox or group.
entries.pitfall: 'Send on behalf' (SendOnBehalf) is another command: Set-Mailbox -GrantSendOnBehalfTo.

entries.name: Get-MailboxStatistics
entries.desc: A mailbox's size, item count and last logon.
entries.pitfall: LastLogonTime can be empty if the mailbox was never opened or not used recently.

entries.name: Get-MessageTraceV2
entries.desc: Traces a message (delivered, delayed, rejected) over the last 10 days. Replaces Get-MessageTrace.
entries.pitfall: Get-MessageTrace is being retired; beyond 10 days, use Start-HistoricalSearch.

entries.name: Start-HistoricalSearch
entries.desc: Starts a message trace search beyond 10 days (up to 90 days), delivered by email.
entries.pitfall: The result does not show in the console: it is sent as a CSV to the notification address.

entries.name: New-TransportRule
entries.desc: Creates a mail flow rule (disclaimer, block, redirect).
entries.pitfall: Create it in test mode (-Mode Audit) before enforcing; rule order (-Priority) matters.

entries.name: Get-DistributionGroupMember
entries.desc: Lists the members of a distribution list.
entries.pitfall: For a Microsoft 365 group, use Get-UnifiedGroupLinks -LinkType Members.

entries.name: Add-DistributionGroupMember
entries.desc: Adds a member to a distribution list.
entries.pitfall: A mail-enabled security group synced from AD cannot be changed here: change it on-premises.

entries.name: Set-CalendarProcessing
entries.desc: Sets automatic meeting acceptance for a room or equipment.
entries.pitfall: -AllowConflicts $false is not enough for recurring meetings: also set -ConflictPercentageAllowed.

entries.name: Add-MailboxFolderPermission
entries.desc: Shares a folder (calendar, inbox) with a user.
entries.pitfall: The folder name depends on the mailbox language (Calendrier in French); check with Get-MailboxFolderStatistics.

entries.name: Get-EXOMailbox
entries.desc: Fast, lightweight version of Get-Mailbox for large volumes.
entries.pitfall: Only the properties requested with -Properties are returned.

entries.name: Enable-Mailbox (archive)
entries.desc: Enables a mailbox's online archive.
entries.pitfall: Requires a licence that includes the archive (Exchange Online Plan 2 or equivalent).

entries.name: Connect-MgGraph
entries.desc: Opens a Microsoft Graph PowerShell session with the requested scopes.
entries.pitfall: A missing scope gives 'Insufficient privileges': reconnect with the right scope.

entries.name: Get-MgUser
entries.desc: Reads a user or lists Entra ID accounts. Replaces Get-MsolUser / Get-AzureADUser.
entries.pitfall: Few properties are returned by default: request them with -Property. Without -All, the list is truncated.

entries.name: New-MgUser
entries.desc: Creates an Entra ID user.
ex: New-MgUser -DisplayName 'Jean Dupont' -UserPrincipalName jean@contoso.com -MailNickname jean -AccountEnabled -PasswordProfile @{ Password = '<mot de passe>'; ForceChangePasswordNextSignIn = $true }
entries.pitfall: Set UsageLocation before assigning a licence.

entries.name: Update-MgUser
entries.desc: Changes a user (department, title, enablement, usage location).
entries.pitfall: Disabling an account does not invalidate current sessions: also use Revoke-MgUserSignInSession.

entries.name: Revoke-MgUserSignInSession
entries.desc: Revokes a user's refresh tokens and sessions (compromised account).
entries.pitfall: Access tokens already issued stay valid for up to about an hour.

entries.name: Set-MgUserLicense
entries.desc: Assigns or removes Microsoft 365 licences.
entries.pitfall: -RemoveLicenses is required even when empty; UsageLocation must be set.

entries.name: Get-MgGroup
entries.desc: Lists Entra ID groups (Microsoft 365, security).
entries.pitfall: Advanced filters (endswith, not) need -ConsistencyLevel eventual -CountVariable n.

entries.name: New-MgGroupMember
entries.desc: Adds a member to an Entra ID group.
entries.pitfall: Not possible on a dynamic-membership group or one synced from AD.

entries.name: Get-MgUserAuthenticationMethod
entries.desc: Lists a user's authentication methods (MFA).
entries.pitfall: The method type is in AdditionalProperties.@odata.type.

entries.name: Get-MgAuditLogSignIn
entries.desc: Entra ID sign-in log (failures, location, conditional access).
entries.pitfall: Retention of only 30 days; the filter does not handle every combination.

entries.name: Get-MgDirectoryRole
entries.desc: Lists the activated administrator roles and their members.
entries.pitfall: A role never assigned does not show until it is activated; PIM membership is not listed here.

entries.name: Get-MgSubscribedSku
entries.desc: The tenant's purchased, consumed and available licences.
entries.pitfall: SkuPartNumber is a technical name (SPE_E3 for Microsoft 365 E3), not the commercial name.

entries.name: Get-MgIdentityConditionalAccessPolicy
entries.desc: Lists conditional access policies.
entries.pitfall: Always put a new policy in 'report-only' mode before enabling it, so you do not lock yourself out.

entries.name: Get-Team
entries.desc: Lists Teams teams.
entries.pitfall: -DisplayName does a prefix search, not an exact name.

entries.name: New-Team
entries.desc: Creates a team (and its Microsoft 365 group).
entries.perms: Teams Administrator; creation may be limited by the group policy
entries.pitfall: Set -Owner: without an owner, the team can be orphaned.

entries.name: Add-TeamUser
entries.desc: Adds a member or owner to a team.
entries.pitfall: For an owner, the user must already be a member.

entries.name: Get-CsOnlineUser
entries.desc: Shows a user's Teams configuration (telephony, policies).
entries.pitfall: An empty policy means 'global default', not 'none'.

entries.name: Grant-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy
entries.desc: Assigns a Teams meeting policy to a user.
entries.pitfall: Up to 24 hours to propagate; for many users, prefer a group assignment (New-CsGroupPolicyAssignment).

entries.name: Get-SPOSite
entries.desc: Lists SharePoint site collections.
entries.pitfall: Without -Limit All, only 200 sites are returned.

entries.name: Set-SPOSite
entries.desc: Changes a site (external sharing, quota, lock).
entries.pitfall: A site's sharing cannot be more open than the tenant's (Set-SPOTenant).

entries.name: Get-SPOTenant
entries.desc: Global SharePoint and OneDrive tenant settings (sharing, sync).
entries.pitfall: A Set-SPOTenant change can take several minutes to apply.

entries.name: Get-SPOUser / Add-SPOUser
entries.desc: Views or adds users in a site.
entries.pitfall: Add-SPOUser requires an existing site group; check the exact name with Get-SPOSiteGroup.

entries.name: Restore-SPODeletedSite
entries.desc: Restores a deleted site (tenant recycle bin, 93 days).
entries.pitfall: A site tied to a Microsoft 365 group is also restored through the deleted group (Entra ID).

entries.name: Get-MgDeviceManagementManagedDevice
entries.desc: Lists devices managed by Intune (compliance, OS, last contact).
entries.pitfall: An old LastSyncDateTime is not a failure: the device may simply be off.

entries.name: Sync-MgDeviceManagementManagedDevice
entries.desc: Requests an immediate sync of an Intune device.
entries.pitfall: The command is only a request: the device must be online to process it.

entries.name: Invoke-MgRetireDeviceManagementManagedDevice
entries.desc: Retires a device from management (removes company data, keeps personal data).
entries.pitfall: Do not confuse with Wipe (full reset, destructive).

entries.name: Get-QuarantineMessage
entries.desc: Lists messages in Defender for Office 365 quarantine.
entries.pitfall: Release with Release-QuarantineMessage -Identity <id> -ReleaseToAll; the default maximum retention is 30 days.

entries.name: Get-MalwareFilterPolicy
entries.desc: Views or sets the anti-malware policy.
entries.pitfall: The default policy applies last; Preset policies can override it.

entries.name: Get-SafeLinksPolicy
entries.desc: Defender for Office 365 Safe Links policies.
entries.pitfall: Requires a Defender for Office 365 licence (Plan 1 or 2).

entries.name: Search-UnifiedAuditLog
entries.desc: Queries the unified audit log (sign-ins, file access, mailbox rules).
entries.perms: 'View-Only Audit Logs' role; auditing enabled on the tenant
entries.pitfall: Limited to 5,000 results per call: paginate with -SessionId and -SessionCommand ReturnLargeSet.

entries.name: New-ComplianceSearch
entries.desc: Creates a Purview eDiscovery content search (then Start-ComplianceSearch).
entries.pitfall: Only use New-ComplianceSearchAction -Purge after checking the results: deletion is permanent.

entries.name: Get-DlpCompliancePolicy
entries.desc: Lists data loss prevention (DLP) policies.
entries.pitfall: A policy in TestWithNotifications mode blocks nothing.

entries.name: Connect-MsolService
entries.desc: Sign-in for the MSOnline module, deprecated. Replace with Connect-MgGraph.
entries.pitfall: The module stops working when its APIs end; do not build scripts on it any more.

entries.name: Connect-AzureAD
entries.desc: Sign-in for the AzureAD module, deprecated. Replace with Connect-MgGraph.
entries.pitfall: Object names change (ObjectId becomes Id) and scopes must be requested again.

entries.name: Set-MsolUserPassword
entries.desc: Resets a password (MSOnline, deprecated). Graph equivalent: Update-MgUser with -PasswordProfile.
ex: Update-MgUser -UserId user@contoso.com -PasswordProfile @{ Password = '<mot de passe>'; ForceChangePasswordNextSignIn = $true }
entries.pitfall: An account synced from on-premises AD is reset on the AD side, not in Entra ID.

entries.name: Get-MailboxPermission
entries.desc: Lists who has access to a mailbox (Full Access, read and manage).
ex: Get-MailboxPermission -Identity shared@contoso.com | Where-Object { $_.User -ne 'NT AUTHORITY\SELF' -and -not $_.IsInherited } | Select-Object User,AccessRights
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: Hide inherited rights and NT AUTHORITY\SELF, or the list is very noisy.

entries.name: Remove-MailboxPermission
entries.desc: Removes a Full Access right from a mailbox.
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: Removal can take several minutes to propagate to Outlook.

entries.name: Get-RecipientPermission
entries.desc: Lists the Send As rights on a mailbox or group.
ex: Get-RecipientPermission -Identity shared@contoso.com | Where-Object { $_.Trustee -ne "NT AUTHORITY\SELF" } | Select-Object Trustee,AccessRights
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: Send As and Send on Behalf (GrantSendOnBehalfTo) are two different rights.

entries.name: Remove-RecipientPermission
entries.desc: Removes a Send As right.
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: Remember to also remove Send on Behalf with Set-Mailbox -GrantSendOnBehalfTo.

entries.name: Set-Mailbox -GrantSendOnBehalfTo
entries.desc: Grants (or removes) Send on Behalf on a mailbox.
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: Without @{Add=…}/@{Remove=…}, the whole list is replaced.

entries.name: Set-Mailbox -EmailAddresses
entries.desc: Adds, removes or replaces a mailbox's aliases (secondary email addresses).
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: On an account synced from on-premises AD, manage aliases in AD (proxyAddresses).

entries.name: Set-Mailbox -Type
entries.desc: Converts a mailbox (e.g. user to shared mailbox when someone leaves).
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: A shared mailbox over 50 GB or with an archive requires an Exchange Online Plan 2 license.

entries.name: Set-Mailbox -ProhibitSendQuota
entries.desc: Sets a mailbox's quotas (warning, prohibit send, prohibit send and receive).
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: Values must respect the license limit (50 GB or 100 GB): IssueWarning < ProhibitSend < ProhibitSendReceive.

entries.name: Get-MailboxFolderStatistics
entries.desc: Size and item count of each folder in a mailbox (find what fills it).
ex: Get-MailboxFolderStatistics -Identity user@contoso.com | Sort-Object FolderSize -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 FolderPath,ItemsInFolder,FolderSize
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: FolderSize is text ("1.2 GB (1,288,490,188 bytes)"): extract the bytes to sort or compute.

entries.name: Get-MailboxFolderPermission
entries.desc: Lists the permissions on a mailbox folder (calendar, inbox).
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: The folder name depends on the mailbox language: \Calendrier in French, \Calendar in English.

entries.name: Set-MailboxFolderPermission
entries.desc: Changes an existing user's permission on a folder (e.g. Reviewer to Editor).
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: Set changes an existing permission; for a new user use Add-MailboxFolderPermission.

entries.name: Remove-MailboxFolderPermission
entries.desc: Removes a user's permission on a mailbox folder.
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: "Default" and "Anonymous" entries cannot be removed: lower their right with Set-.

entries.name: Get-InboxRule
entries.desc: Lists inbox rules (spot a hidden forwarding after a compromise).
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: Attackers often create hidden rules: add -IncludeHidden.

entries.name: Remove-InboxRule
entries.desc: Deletes an inbox rule.
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: Identify the rule by its Identity (RuleIdentity) if several share a name.

entries.name: Get-Recipient
entries.desc: Finds which object (mailbox, group, contact) an address belongs to, aliases included.
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: Useful when "the address is already in use": it may belong to a group or contact.

entries.name: Get-User
entries.desc: Reads a user's directory attributes: first name, last name, department, title, manager.
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: First and last names are not in Get-Mailbox: you need Get-User (or Get-MgUser) to export them.

entries.name: Set-User
entries.desc: Changes a user's first name, last name, department or title.
ex: Set-User -Identity user@contoso.com -FirstName Alice -LastName Martin -Department Comptabilité -Title "Responsable comptable"
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: On an account synced from on-premises AD, the change is made in AD.

entries.name: Get-CASMailbox
entries.desc: Shows a mailbox's enabled protocols (IMAP, POP, ActiveSync, MAPI, EWS, OWA).
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: Disabling basic authentication is also done tenant-wide (Authentication Policy / Security Defaults).

entries.name: Set-CASMailbox
entries.desc: Turns IMAP, POP, ActiveSync… on or off for a mailbox.
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: An application that reads the mailbox over IMAP/POP will stop working: check first.

entries.name: Set-MailboxRegionalConfiguration
entries.desc: Sets a mailbox's language, time zone and date format.
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: Without -LocalizeDefaultFolderName, folders (Inbox, Sent Items) keep their English names.

entries.name: Get-DistributionGroup
entries.desc: Lists distribution groups (mailing lists) and their owners.
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: Microsoft 365 groups are returned by Get-UnifiedGroup, not Get-DistributionGroup.

entries.name: New-DistributionGroup
entries.desc: Creates a distribution group (mailing list).
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: By default only internal senders can write to the group: -RequireSenderAuthenticationEnabled $false to open it.

entries.name: Remove-DistributionGroupMember
entries.desc: Removes a member from a distribution group.
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: A group synced from on-premises AD is changed in AD.

entries.name: Get-UnifiedGroup
entries.desc: Lists Microsoft 365 groups (Teams teams, Outlook groups, sites).
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: Members are read with Get-UnifiedGroupLinks -LinkType Members.

entries.name: Add-UnifiedGroupLinks
entries.desc: Adds members or owners to a Microsoft 365 group.
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: An owner must first be a member of the group.

entries.name: New-MailContact
entries.desc: Creates an external mail contact (visible in the directory, usable in groups).
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: A contact has no mailbox: it only receives messages forwarded to its external address.

entries.name: Undo-SoftDeletedMailbox
entries.desc: Restores a mailbox deleted less than 30 days ago (account deleted in Entra ID).
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: Simpler: restore the user in Entra ID (recycle bin, 30 days): the mailbox comes back with it.

entries.name: Get-MobileDevice
entries.desc: Lists the mobile devices synced (ActiveSync) with a mailbox.
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: For remote wipe: Clear-MobileDevice (or Intune for enrolled devices).

entries.name: Remove-MobileDevice
entries.desc: Removes a mobile device's sync relationship (loss, replacement).
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: The device will resync if it reconnects with valid credentials.

entries.name: Get-AcceptedDomain
entries.desc: Lists the tenant's accepted (mail) domains.
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: DomainType InternalRelay means a domain shared with another mail system (migration in progress).

entries.name: Get-DkimSigningConfig
entries.desc: Shows a domain's DKIM signing state and the CNAME records to publish.
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: Publish the two CNAME records (selector1 and selector2) in DNS first; enabling fails otherwise.

entries.name: New-DkimSigningConfig
entries.desc: Creates the DKIM configuration for a custom domain.
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: Create it disabled, publish the CNAMEs, then enable with Set-DkimSigningConfig -Enabled $true.

entries.name: Get-HostedOutboundSpamFilterPolicy
entries.desc: Checks the outbound spam policy, in particular automatic forwarding to external recipients.
entries.perms: Exchange Administrator or the matching management role
entries.pitfall: AutoForwardingMode Automatic (the default) blocks external forwarding: the #1 cause of a forward "not working".

entries.name: Get-TransportRule
entries.desc: Lists mail flow rules (disclaimers, redirections, blocks).
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: Order (Priority) matters: a "stop processing" rule can prevent later ones.

entries.name: Get-InboundConnector
entries.desc: Lists inbound and outbound mail connectors (relays, partners, on-premises server).
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: A poorly restricted connector (SenderIPAddresses) can open a relay; check the allowed addresses.

entries.name: Get-MessageTraceDetailV2
entries.desc: Step-by-step journey of a message found with Get-MessageTraceV2.
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: Limited to the last 10 days; beyond that, Start-HistoricalSearch.

entries.name: Release-QuarantineMessage
entries.desc: Releases a message from quarantine (false positive).
entries.perms: Security Administrator or Quarantine Administrator role
entries.pitfall: A high-confidence phishing message can only be released by an administrator.

entries.name: Get-AntiPhishPolicy
entries.desc: Shows the anti-phishing policies (impersonation, protected users).
entries.pitfall: The default policy applies to everyone: create a dedicated one for executives.

entries.name: Get-SafeAttachmentPolicy
entries.desc: Shows Defender for Office 365 Safe Attachments policies.
entries.pitfall: Only available with a Defender for Office 365 license (Plan 1 or 2).

entries.name: Remove-MgUser
entries.desc: Deletes an Entra ID user (kept 30 days in the recycle bin).
entries.pitfall: The mailbox and OneDrive go with the account: transfer what is needed first.

entries.name: Update-MgUser -AccountEnabled
entries.desc: Blocks (or re-enables) a user's sign-in without deleting the account.
entries.pitfall: Open sessions stay valid for a while: also revoke them with Revoke-MgUserSignInSession.

entries.name: Get-MgUserMemberOf
entries.desc: Lists the groups and directory roles a user is a member of.
entries.pitfall: The name is in AdditionalProperties.displayName, not a direct property.

entries.name: Get-MgUserLicenseDetail
entries.desc: Lists the licenses and service plans assigned to a user.
ex: Get-MgUserLicenseDetail -UserId user@contoso.com | Select-Object -ExpandProperty ServicePlans | Where-Object ProvisioningStatus -eq "Disabled"
entries.pitfall: SkuPartNumber (e.g. SPE_E3) is not the marketing name; cross-check with Get-MgSubscribedSku.

entries.name: Get-MgUserManager
entries.desc: Shows a user's manager.
entries.pitfall: Returns a 404 error if no manager is set: this is not a fault.

entries.name: Get-MgGroupMember
entries.desc: Lists the members of an Entra ID / Microsoft 365 group.
entries.pitfall: Without -All, only 100 members are returned.

entries.name: New-MgGroup
entries.desc: Creates a security group (or a Microsoft 365 group with GroupTypes).
entries.pitfall: MailNickname is required, even for a security group without mail.

entries.name: Remove-MgGroupMemberByRef
entries.desc: Removes a member from an Entra ID group.
entries.pitfall: You need the user's ID (GUID), not the address.

entries.name: Get-MgReportAuthenticationMethodUserRegistrationDetail
entries.desc: Each user's MFA registration state (who has no strong authentication method).
entries.perms: AuditLog.Read.All; Reports Reader or Security Reader role
entries.pitfall: Requires Entra ID P1/P2 for some report fields.

entries.name: Get-MgAuditLogDirectoryAudit
entries.desc: Directory audit log: who created, changed or deleted what.
ex: Get-MgAuditLogDirectoryAudit -Filter "activityDisplayName eq 'Add member to role'" -Top 20 | Select-Object ActivityDateTime,ActivityDisplayName,Result
entries.pitfall: Kept 30 days (7 on free Entra ID): export what needs to last.

entries.name: Get-MgDomain
entries.desc: Lists the tenant's domains (verified, default) and their status.
entries.pitfall: Get-MgDomainVerificationDnsRecord gives the TXT record to publish to verify a domain.

entries.name: Get-MgOrganization
entries.desc: Tenant information (name, ID, technical contacts, sync).
entries.pitfall: OnPremisesSyncEnabled True: accounts are mostly managed in on-premises AD.

entries.name: Get-MgDevice
entries.desc: Lists the devices registered in Entra ID (joined, hybrid, registered).
entries.pitfall: Inactive devices pile up: filter on ApproximateLastSignInDateTime to clean up.

entries.name: Get-MgDirectoryRoleMember
entries.desc: Lists the members of an admin role (who is a Global Administrator, etc.).
entries.pitfall: A role only appears if it has already been activated: otherwise Get-MgDirectoryRole does not return it.

entries.name: Get-MgApplication
entries.desc: Lists app registrations (and their expiring secrets).
entries.pitfall: An expired secret silently breaks the app: watch EndDateTime.

entries.name: Get-TeamUser
entries.desc: Lists a Teams team's members and owners.
entries.pitfall: A team is identified by its GroupId (GUID), not its name.

entries.name: Remove-TeamUser
entries.desc: Removes a member from a Teams team.
entries.pitfall: An owner must be removed with -Role Owner first if they are the last one.

entries.name: Get-TeamChannel
entries.desc: Lists a team's channels (standard, private, shared).
entries.pitfall: Private channels have their own member list: Get-TeamChannelUser.

entries.name: Set-Team
entries.desc: Changes a team’s settings (name, visibility, member and guest rights).
entries.pitfall: The team name is the Microsoft 365 group name: propagation can take time.

entries.name: New-SPOSite
entries.desc: Creates a SharePoint site.
entries.pitfall: STS#3 creates a team site without a Microsoft 365 group; for a site with a group, use the UI or PnP.

entries.name: Remove-SPOSite
entries.desc: Moves a SharePoint site to the tenant recycle bin (restorable for 93 days).
entries.pitfall: Remove-SPODeletedSite deletes permanently: only run it knowingly.

entries.name: Get-SPOExternalUser
entries.desc: Lists the SharePoint tenant's external (guest) users.
entries.pitfall: Loop on -Position to list them all (50 per page maximum).

entries.name: Invoke-MgWipeDeviceManagementManagedDevice
entries.desc: Remotely wipes an Intune-managed device (loss, theft, recycling).
entries.pitfall: Irreversible. On a personal device, prefer "Retire" (Invoke-MgRetire…) which only removes company data.

entries.name: Get-MgDeviceManagementDeviceCompliancePolicy
entries.desc: Lists the Intune compliance policies.
entries.pitfall: A device with no assigned compliance policy is treated as compliant by default (tenant setting).

entries.name: Script: export every Exchange Online mailbox (name, address, size, aliases, forwarding)
entries.desc: Exports every mailbox to CSV: first name, last name, primary address, type, size and item count, quotas, aliases, forwarding (mailbox and rules), archive, last logon.
ex:
# Prerequisite : Install-Module ExchangeOnlineManagement -Scope CurrentUser
Connect-ExchangeOnline -ShowBanner:$false

$IncludeInboxRules = $true   # $false to go faster (rules are read mailbox by mailbox)

function ConvertTo-Mb($size) {
    if (-not $size) { return $null }
    $m = [regex]::Match("$size", '\(([\d\s,.\u00A0\u202F]+) bytes\)')
    if ($m.Success) { [math]::Round([decimal]($m.Groups[1].Value -replace '[^\d]', '') / 1MB, 1) }
}

# First name, last name, department and title come from Get-User (not in Get-Mailbox)
$users = @{}
Get-User -ResultSize Unlimited | ForEach-Object { $users[$_.UserPrincipalName] = $_ }

$props = 'DisplayName','PrimarySmtpAddress','UserPrincipalName','EmailAddresses','RecipientTypeDetails',
         'ForwardingAddress','ForwardingSmtpAddress','DeliverToMailboxAndForward','GrantSendOnBehalfTo',
         'ProhibitSendQuota','ProhibitSendReceiveQuota','IssueWarningQuota','ArchiveStatus',
         'LitigationHoldEnabled','HiddenFromAddressListsEnabled','WhenCreated'
$mailboxes = Get-EXOMailbox -ResultSize Unlimited -Properties $props
$i = 0
$rows = foreach ($mb in $mailboxes) {
    $i++; Write-Progress -Activity 'Exporting mailboxes' -Status $mb.PrimarySmtpAddress -PercentComplete ($i / $mailboxes.Count * 100)
    $u     = $users[$mb.UserPrincipalName]
    $stats = Get-EXOMailboxStatistics -Identity $mb.UserPrincipalName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    $rules = if ($IncludeInboxRules) {
        Get-InboxRule -Mailbox $mb.UserPrincipalName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Where-Object { $_.ForwardTo -or $_.ForwardAsAttachmentTo -or $_.RedirectTo }
    }
    [pscustomobject]@{
        FirstName             = $u.FirstName
        LastName                = $u.LastName
        DisplayName         = $mb.DisplayName
        Department            = $u.Department
        Title           = $u.Title
        PrimaryAddress  = $mb.PrimarySmtpAddress
        UPN                = $mb.UserPrincipalName
        Type               = $mb.RecipientTypeDetails
        SizeMB           = ConvertTo-Mb $stats.TotalItemSize
        ItemCount         = $stats.ItemCount
        LastLogon  = $stats.LastLogonTime
        WarningQuota        = "$($mb.IssueWarningQuota)"
        ProhibitSendQuota = "$($mb.ProhibitSendQuota)"
        ProhibitSendReceiveQuota         = "$($mb.ProhibitSendReceiveQuota)"
        Alias              = ($mb.EmailAddresses | Where-Object { $_ -clike 'smtp:*' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Substring(5) }) -join ';'
        MailboxForwarding     = (@($mb.ForwardingAddress, $mb.ForwardingSmtpAddress) | Where-Object { $_ }) -join ';'
        KeepCopy     = $mb.DeliverToMailboxAndForward
        RuleForwarding    = ($rules | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Name) -> " + (@($_.ForwardTo + $_.ForwardAsAttachmentTo + $_.RedirectTo) -join ',') }) -join ' | '
        SendOnBehalfOf  = ($mb.GrantSendOnBehalfTo -join ';')
        Archive            = $mb.ArchiveStatus
        LitigationHold = $mb.LitigationHoldEnabled
        HiddenFromAddressList    = $mb.HiddenFromAddressListsEnabled
        Created              = $mb.WhenCreated
    }
}
$rows | Sort-Object LastName, FirstName | Export-Csv .\exchange-mailboxes-export.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8 -Delimiter ';'
Write-Host "$($rows.Count) mailboxes exported to exchange-mailboxes-export.csv"
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: Slow on a large tenant (one statistics request per mailbox): run it off-peak. The CSV opens in Excel with the ";" separator.

entries.name: Script: export mailbox sizes, largest first
entries.desc: Ranks mailboxes by size (GB), with quota and percentage used, to spot those about to fill up.
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: The quota comes from ProhibitSendReceiveQuota: for a mailbox with an archive, add Get-EXOMailboxStatistics -Archive.

entries.name: Script: list every mail forward (mailboxes and rules)
entries.desc: Forwarding audit: forwards set on the mailbox and inbox rules that redirect to outside recipients.
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: Run it regularly: a redirection to the outside is the classic sign of a compromised account.

entries.name: Script: audit delegations (Full Access, Send As, Send on Behalf)
entries.desc: Lists, for each mailbox, who can open it, send as it or on its behalf.
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: A shared mailbox with no clear owner is a risk: spot those whose access is old.

entries.name: Script: export Entra ID users (licenses, last sign-in)
entries.desc: Exports users with department, title, manager, licenses, last sign-in and enabled state.
ex:
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'User.Read.All','AuditLog.Read.All','Organization.Read.All'
$sku = @{}; Get-MgSubscribedSku | ForEach-Object { $sku[$_.SkuId] = $_.SkuPartNumber }
$props = 'Id','DisplayName','GivenName','Surname','UserPrincipalName','Mail','Department','JobTitle','AccountEnabled','CreatedDateTime','UserType','AssignedLicenses','SignInActivity'
Get-MgUser -All -Property $props -ExpandProperty Manager | ForEach-Object {
    [pscustomobject]@{
        FirstName            = $_.GivenName
        LastName               = $_.Surname
        UPN               = $_.UserPrincipalName
        Mail              = $_.Mail
        Department           = $_.Department
        Title          = $_.JobTitle
        Manager           = $_.Manager.AdditionalProperties.userPrincipalName
        Enabled             = $_.AccountEnabled
        Type              = $_.UserType
        Licenses          = ($_.AssignedLicenses | ForEach-Object { $sku[$_.SkuId] }) -join ';'
        LastLogon = $_.SignInActivity.LastSignInDateTime
        Created              = $_.CreatedDateTime
    }
} | Export-Csv .\entra-users.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8 -Delimiter ';'
entries.pitfall: SignInActivity requires an Entra ID P1 license; without it the column stays empty.

entries.name: Script: accounts inactive for more than 90 days
entries.desc: Finds accounts with no sign-in for 90 days (candidates for disabling or license removal).
ex:
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'User.Read.All','AuditLog.Read.All'
$limite = (Get-Date).AddDays(-90)
Get-MgUser -All -Filter "accountEnabled eq true and userType eq 'Member'" -Property DisplayName,UserPrincipalName,SignInActivity,AssignedLicenses |
    Where-Object { $_.SignInActivity.LastSignInDateTime -lt $limite -or -not $_.SignInActivity.LastSignInDateTime } |
    Select-Object DisplayName, UserPrincipalName,
        @{n='LastLogon'; e={ $_.SignInActivity.LastSignInDateTime }},
        @{n='LicenseCount'; e={ $_.AssignedLicenses.Count }} |
    Sort-Object LastLogon | Export-Csv .\inactive-accounts.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8 -Delimiter ';'
entries.pitfall: Service and shared-mailbox accounts have no regular sign-in: exclude them before acting.

entries.name: Script: users with no MFA method registered
entries.desc: Lists enabled users who have not registered multifactor authentication.
ex:
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'AuditLog.Read.All','User.Read.All'
$actifs = Get-MgUser -All -Filter 'accountEnabled eq true' -Property UserPrincipalName | Select-Object -ExpandProperty UserPrincipalName
Get-MgReportAuthenticationMethodUserRegistrationDetail -All |
    Where-Object { $_.UserPrincipalName -in $actifs -and -not $_.IsMfaRegistered } |
    Select-Object UserDisplayName, UserPrincipalName, DefaultMfaMethod |
    Export-Csv .\no-mfa.csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8 -Delimiter ';'
entries.pitfall: Guests and service accounts also appear: filter on UserType and exclusions.

entries.name: Script: members of every distribution group (export)
entries.desc: Exports, for each distribution group, the list of its members.
entries.perms: Exchange 'View-Only Recipients' role or Exchange Administrator
entries.pitfall: Microsoft 365 groups are read with Get-UnifiedGroup / Get-UnifiedGroupLinks.

entries.name: Script: create users from a CSV file (Graph)
entries.desc: Creates Microsoft 365 accounts from a CSV (first name, last name, address, department) and assigns a license.
entries.pitfall: UsageLocation is required before assigning a license. Do not store plain-text passwords: generate them on the fly.

entries.name: Script: leaver procedure (block, revoke, shared mailbox, licenses)
entries.desc: Leaver procedure: blocks sign-in, revokes sessions, converts the mailbox to shared, removes licenses.
ex:
param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$User)
Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'User.ReadWrite.All'
Connect-ExchangeOnline -ShowBanner:$false

Update-MgUser -UserId $User -AccountEnabled:$false                       # 1. block sign-in
Revoke-MgUserSignInSession -UserId $User | Out-Null                      # 2. cut open sessions
Set-Mailbox -Identity $User -Type Shared                                 # 3. shared mailbox (keeps the mail)
Set-Mailbox -Identity $User -HiddenFromAddressListsEnabled $true         # 4. hide from the address list
$lic = (Get-MgUserLicenseDetail -UserId $User).SkuId                     # 5. remove licenses
if ($lic) { Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $User -AddLicenses @() -RemoveLicenses $lic | Out-Null }
Write-Host "Leaver handled for $User"
entries.pitfall: Remove licenses last: a shared mailbox keeps its content without a license up to 50 GB, not beyond. Test on a test account first.
